$comment: ★★ CODE AFTER A TERMINATOR INSIDE AN INLINE-ASM TEMPLATE, WITH NO LABEL BETWEEN THEM (P68 round 8, D-ASM-INSTRUCTION-AFTER-A-TERMINATOR-REFUSED). A dead line after a jump to `1:`, one after a jump to `2:` at the template's end, and one after the jump over the other arm of a conditional branch whose fall-through is the next line; each dead line changes the result if it runs, and exit codes 11–12 name the shape that went wrong. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-23: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 run this file to 42 on x86_64 and aarch64 (qemu), at -O0 and -O2. DSS refused the dead line as code 'it cannot place in a basic block'; it now begins a block of the statement's own body, laid out in the text's order with the template's other blocks. ★ RED-ON-DISABLE: refuse an instruction after a terminator again and every arm here is refused at compile time.
